title: Career cities Part 7: Asia, part two, with Ledger in under 2 minutes
summary: Part 7 of the career cities series covers 9 niche hubs across southeast asia, one sourced fact and the jobs available at each stop, as Hoang asked on 15 Nov.

beats.voice: Career cities with Ledger, part seven: Asia, part two, in under two minutes.

caption:
Career cities with Ledger, Part 7, is the second trip across Asia, through Southeast Asia, with 9 stops, and each stop shows one niche industry that town is a hub for, with a sourced fact and the jobs you could have there

So you will meet Bac Ninh, Phnom Penh, Rayong, Penang, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Morowali, Seria, and Manila

Save the map for later, because Part 8 maps career cities across South Asia, the Gulf and Central Asia

openQuestions: Kuala Lumpur is a second Malaysian stop (Penang is the first) because no other Southeast Asian hub had an opened source; tell me if you want a Thai (Samut Sakhon seafood), Laos or Vietnam (Haiphong, VinFast) swap instead
Phnom Penh, Rayong, Singapore and Manila facts are country or sector figures, not city figures; Manila's source is datelined Manila only, and the Metro Manila link is the weakest of the part
Brunei's Seria is a town, not a city; the Lumut LNG plant could not be sourced
Mixed currencies inside the post (ringgit, baht, dollars) because each figure stays in the currency it was reported in; I can convert nothing without new sources
